title: Bumblebee dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings with motion -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="30" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#a8d8f0" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(-30 36 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="30" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#a8d8f0" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(30 64 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="26" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#d0eefc" opacity="0.7" transform="rotate(-50 30 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="26" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#d0eefc" opacity="0.7" transform="rotate(50 70 26)"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#f7c631"/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d="M30 48 Q50 42 70 48 L70 54 Q50 48 30 54 Z" fill="#3a2a10"/>
  <path d="M29 60 Q50 54 71 60 L71 66 Q50 60 29 66 Z" fill="#3a2a10"/>
  <path d="M32 68 Q50 62 68 68 L68 70 Q50 64 32 70 Z" fill="#3a2a10"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="44" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#ffe58a" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="13" fill="#f7c631"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#ffe58a" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="28" r="3.2" fill="#2a1a05"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="28" r="3.2" fill="#2a1a05"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="27" r="1.2" fill="#fff8dc"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="27" r="1.2" fill="#fff8dc"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M45 34 Q50 39 55 34" fill="none" stroke="#2a1a05" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d="M44 18 Q40 10 35 8" fill="none" stroke="#3a2a10" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="8" r="2.2" fill="#f7c631"/>
  <path d="M56 18 Q60 10 65 8" fill="none" stroke="#3a2a10" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="8" r="2.2" fill="#f7c631"/>
  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d="M36 72 Q28 82 22 78" fill="none" stroke="#3a2a10" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64 72 Q72 82 78 78" fill="none" stroke="#3a2a10" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M42 74 Q38 84 32 86" fill="none" stroke="#3a2a10" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 74 Q62 84 68 86" fill="none" stroke="#3a2a10" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d="M50 75 L50 82" stroke="#3a2a10" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
